tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and project guidelines to understand TLH as an isolated Pi package and the repository safety constraints.

tour.title: Installer Entry Point
tour.description: Inspect the installer and uninstall wrapper flow that creates the isolated tlh command without mutating normal Pi configuration.

tour.title: Settings and Default Extension Management
tour.description: Follow how installer-owned defaults are merged, disabled defaults are respected, and Gnosis/default extension helpers manage isolated profile state.

tour.title: Runtime Extension Surface
tour.description: Explore the package extension entrypoints and footer/update/usage modules that integrate TLH behavior into Pi sessions.

tour.title: Primary Agents and Delegation Prompts
tour.description: Review the primary agent prompts and subagent prompts that define architect, rush, product, bug-hunter, developer, and reviewer roles.

tour.title: Validation and Regression Tests
tour.description: Use the tests layer to understand expected installer behavior, prompt contracts, runtime extension behavior, and safety policies.

tour.title: Documentation and Release Process
tour.description: Finish with user documentation, local development guidance, web-search notes, and release checklist to see how changes are shipped.
